{{Top|leg}}
A '''gravfield generator''' was a small reverse [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generator. Commonly used in [[Reversed repulsorfield|man traps]], gravfield generators&mdash;despite their small size&mdash;were capable of intensifying local [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] fields up to a factor of eight, and were capable of generating fields so strong that not even a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] could escape.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Due to the power of gravfield generators, they could have a number of detrimental side effects to living [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], such as in the [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]; a pinned subject's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] often struggled under the heavy gravity, while vital fluids were forced through grav-compressed passages that could burst from the strain. [[Blood/Legends|Blood]] could pool in abdominal organs, while the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] starved from lack of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Cardiac arrest was also highly likely.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
